subject.title: fix(dreaming): drop heartbeat assistant responses from dream corpus

question: Should heartbeat cleanup ship with whole-corpus archival and reset of both ingestion namespaces before interruption and concurrent-ingestion recovery are explicitly proven?
rationale: The corpus is derived and archived, but the repair mutates persisted checkpoint state across multiple operations; deciding whether current proof is enough requires maintainer ownership of the acceptable upgrade and recovery boundary.

options.title: Require convergence proof
options.body: Add focused fault-path coverage showing rerunning Doctor repairs corpus/checkpoint mismatches after either half of the rebuild operation fails, and document or guard concurrent Gateway ingestion.

options.title: Accept full rebuild semantics
options.body: Land the current repair as an intentional derived-state reset, accepting full re-ingestion cost and the existing multi-operation repair model.

recommendation.title: Require convergence proof
recommendation.body: Add focused fault-path coverage showing rerunning Doctor repairs corpus/checkpoint mismatches after either half of the rebuild operation fails, and document or guard concurrent Gateway ingestion.
